review_notes.note: 牙痛伴隨胸痛、心悸、發燒、吞嚥或張口困難等症狀，可能表示感染擴散或其他嚴重問題，需優先評估。例如，深頸部感染（如咽後膿瘍）可能導致呼吸道阻塞，而心臟症狀可能與感染引發的全身性反應或潛在心臟問題有關。

rag_sources.title: Trichomoniasis: Background, Pathophysiology, Etiology
rag_sources.excerpt: Trichomoniasis is thought to be widely underdiagnosed owing to various factors, including a lack of routine testing, the low sensitivity of a commonly used diagnostic technique (wet mount microscopy), and nonspecific symptomatology. Self-diagnosis and self-treatment or diagnosis by practitioners without adequate laboratory testing may also contribute to misdiagnosis. Although bacterial labyrinthitis is rare in the postantibiotic era, bacterial meningitis remains a significant cause of hearing loss. Auditory symptoms, vestibular symptoms, or both may be present in as many as 20% of children with meningitis.
